title.narrative: Share of value of exports (% of total world) of goods manufactured in West Africa to the global market

description.narrative: ITC comment: The indicator was proposed by the EU monitoring expert after the ROM exercise. We could not find a corresponding indicator on OPSYS. The specific wording used does not allow to use one of the available OPSYS indicators, although it is very close to Exports by developing countries and LDCs as a share of global exports of goods and services. The current description is complex as current export data do not define the level of manufacturing that occurred in West Africa. ITC raised this concerns to the EU monitoring expert.The ECOWAS share of global exports (of goods) in 2015 was already 0.52% and it grew to 0.63% in 2019.For reference: UNCTADStats https://unctadstat.unctad.org/wds/TableViewer/tableView.aspx?ReportId24397

comment.narrative: ITC comment For the baseline data the correct figure would be 0.523 in 2015 but the system dos not seem to allow figures that are below 1
There is a problem in the OPSYS system. The value to be reported for 2019 is 0.63. The system however does not seem to allow to report figures that are between 0 and 1

title.narrative: Global Competitiveness Index (average for the ECOWAS countries)

description.narrative: The indicator is supposed to be based on the WEF Global Competitiveness Index, but the values are supposed to be presented as averages of West Africa countries (for which this data is available)ITC comment: The indicator was proposed by the EU monitoring expert after the ROM exercise. We could not find a corresponding indicator on OPSYS. The specific wording used does not allow to use one of the available OPSYS indicators, although it is very close to Global Competitiveness Index, since what is required to be calculated is an average of West Africa countries on not a straightforward Global Competitiveness Index score. In addition to that, the Global Competitiveness Index has changed its scoring system In 2015 the score was given out of 7 (GCR 20152016 http://www3.weforum.org/docs/gcr/20152016/GlobalCompetitivenessReport20152016.pdf). Since 2019, the competitive index goes from 0100 (GCR 2019 http://www3.weforum.org/docs/WEFTheGlobalCompetitivenessReport2019.pdf). ITC raised these concerns to the EU monitoring expert.

comment.narrative: 2024.07.05 This is a tentative value only to be able to work on the OPSYS not having a target value seemed to create problems in the validation of the logframe
